descriptions: {g:He|She} lives simply, off the beaten tracks of {place}.
{g:He|She} knows everyone in the village and keeps nothing to {g:himself|herself}.
Word is {g:he|she} crossed paths with {creature} one foggy night.
{g:He|She} tills a small plot near {place}, with calloused hands and a bent back.
{g:He|She} still talks about {event} with a tremble in {g:his|her} voice.
{g:He|She} keeps a pitchfork within reach ever since {creature} was seen prowling.
{g:He|She} wears fine clothes, but the lands around {place} are failing.
{g:He|She} owes a great debt to {owner} and dislikes being reminded.
{g:He|She} smiles politely and never forgets an insult.
{g:He|She} spends nights over old tomes that speak of {event}.
{g:He|She} has spent years looking for what {g:he|she} lost near {place}.
{g:He|She} has {g:his|her} nose in {g:his|her} notes and forgets to eat.
{g:He|She} tends a small shrine in {place} and listens more than {g:he|she} speaks.
{g:He|She} has blessed more dead than newborn since {event}.
{g:He|She} prays for those {creature} left homeless.
{g:He|She} counts coins twice, out of habit.
{g:He|She} has good deals to offer, and better ones to hide.
Business has taken {g:him|her} to {place} and beyond.
{g:He|She} keeps a tidy stall and knows the price of everything.
{g:He|She} brings rare goods from {place}, at prices just as rare.
{g:He|She} lost a whole cargo to {creature}.
{g:He|She} serves a thick stew and even thicker rumours.
{g:He|She} keeps a cudgel under the counter, just in case.
{g:He|She} houses travellers from {place} and pries their stories out of them.
{g:He|She} has forge-blackened arms and steady hands.
{g:He|She} learned the trade from {maker}.
{g:He|She} forges the old way, wasting nothing.
{g:He|She} drags a basket full of knick-knacks and promises.
{g:He|She} walks the roads of {place} and knows who needs what.
{g:He|She} swears {g:he|she} once sold a charm to {owner}.
{g:He|She} keeps watch, hand on the pommel, eyeing strangers sideways.
{g:He|She} saw {event} with {g:his|her} own eyes and never speaks of it.
{g:He|She} has served {owner} for years without asking questions.
{g:He|She} lives outside the law, somewhere near {place}.
{g:He|She} has a wanted poster in more than one town.
{g:He|She} avoids the roads since {creature} was spotted nearby.
{g:He|She} robs travellers on the road to {place}.
{g:He|She} made a living robbing {owner} and never boasted about it.
{g:He|She} grins broadly, blade already drawn.
{g:He|She} whispers forbidden prayers while staring at the stars.
{g:He|She} believes {event} was only the beginning.
{g:He|She} watches over a hidden altar, not far from {place}.
{g:He|She} hires out {g:his|her} sword to the highest bidder, no regrets.
{g:He|She} fought through {event} and bears the scars.
{g:He|She} was hired by {owner} for a job best left unspoken.
It prowls near {place}, always watchful.
It has already caused the villagers plenty of trouble.
It moves without a sound and stops at nothing.
It howls at the moon above {place}.
It trails the herd at a distance, patiently.
It stalks belated travellers, eyes gleaming.
It has just left hibernation, hungry and ill-tempered.
It defends its den near {place} with fury.
It leaves clawed trees at man height behind it.
It weaves its web between the trees of {place}.
It waits motionless for prey to stumble into the trap.
Its fangs drip with a greenish venom.
It roots up the ground of {place}, grunting.
It charges headlong whenever someone gets close.
It has already wounded more than one hunter.
